description: Diagnose one school's policy: what stands between the school and a policy, read and nothing else. No model is called, nothing is saved and nothing in the store is changed. Give unitid. The answer gives walks, the school's catalog captures with what Gather coded as policy in each; pages_the_open_would_read, the pages playlist_policy_open would read now, how many the folder list picks and whether the courseleaf stopgap stood in for it; gather_policy_coded and harvest_policy_records_name, each page Gather coded as policy and each file Harvest's policy records name, marked chosen or left out with the reason (not on the list, an excluded segment, not HTML, an older copy of the address, not held); policies_held, every policy row held for the school with its status, trust_state, built_by, created_at, its pages and the pages it lacks against what would be read now, and which one is in use; open_would_answer, the outcome playlist_policy_open would give now (hit, stale, miss or no_pages) and why; award_titles, each award title with its programs' published credits, whether the policy in use has a rule for it, and what the server could infer for its minimum credits; and area_lines, each area line with the number of captured pages that print it. Read-only.
